svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sides (make 2, a left and a right): 170 x 282 mm blanks; fold a 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot outward along the bottom; the side stands 262 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each foot 6.5 mm, 10 mm out from the fold, 25 and 145 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front: 233 x 210 mm, with a window 170 x 130 mm, 30 mm up from its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge; rivet a perforated panel behind the window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinges: two 30 mm butt hinges riveted to the left side and the front,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm from the top and bottom of the front. Latch on the right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the feet sit on the base plate with two M6 screws each; the sides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand 115 mm each side of the axis, 75 mm behind it to 95 mm in front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The front's bottom edge is 60 mm above the bench, so the handwheel is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reached under it with the front shut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the front swings open and latches; deburr every cut edge.
